rationale: Base post-contingency case overloads l12 at 133.3% (100 MW vs 75 MW). Opening l23, l24, or l34 does not relieve l12 and remains infeasible (max loadings 160%, 160%, 133.3%). Closing the normally-open tie l14 creates a parallel path b1-b4, redistributing flow and bringing all loadings within limits: max loading 94.29% on l12, with l23 67.1%, l24 34.3%, l34 32.9%, l14 58.6%. Topology stays connected and only one corrective switch (budget 1) is used.
